# GroupedBarChart

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Grouped bar chart that renders multiple bars per category. Extends CartesianChartBase and uses standard ChartData model with ChartSeries. Uses the ICanvas interface for rendering, making it backend-agnostic.

Namespace `BonniePDF`. Extends `CartesianChartBase`.

## Constructors

```csharp
new GroupedBarChart()
new GroupedBarChart(ChartData data)
```

## Properties

- [`BarStyle`](#barstyle): Value-end rounding and optional opaque linear gradient.
- [`BarWidthRatio`](#barwidthratio): Width of bars as percentage of available space (0.0 to 1.0, default: 0.6).
- [`GroupGapRatio`](#groupgapratio): Gap between groups as percentage of available space (0.0 to 1.0, default: 0.2).
